name: meridian.member.open-sub-account
description: Open a new sub-account of a given type for a member with an opening deposit, and return the confirmation number. This capability posts an irreversible transaction.

memberId.description: The member number. (PII — redacted in logs)

openingDeposit.description: Opening deposit amount in dollars. Minimum 25.

confirmationNumber.description: Core confirmation number for the posting.

newAccountNumber.description: The account number assigned to the new sub-account. Declared PII: it is an account number, so it is pseudonymised in logs and evidence — but returning it is the point of this capability, and a reviewer has approved the caller receiving it.

outcomes.description: The opening deposit was below the product minimum, so nothing was opened.
The opening deposit was not a valid amount.
No member record exists for the number supplied.

name: meridian.member.savings-balance
description: Look up a member by number in MERIDIAN Core and return the current balance of their share savings account.

memberId.description: The member number to look up. (PII — redacted in logs)

memberName.description: The member's name as held on the core.

ssnLast4.description: Last four digits of the member's SSN.

savingsBalance.description: Current balance of the share savings account in dollars.

outcomes.description: No member record exists for the number supplied.
The member number supplied was not numeric.
The operator is not authorised to view this member record.
